title: What's New: Enhancements to Job Queue (2024 release wave 2)

chapters.title: Job Queue Fundamentals and Category Codes
Previous Job Queue Behavior and Limitations

features.name: Job Queue Category Code Queueing
features.description: Changed job queue behavior for category codes from retry-based polling to a proper queue system where tasks with the same category code line up and wait their turn, with the previous task activating the next one when complete.
features.status_evidence_quote: with this wave we technically already released it but it belongs to this
caveats: Only applies to jobs with the same category code
Typically used for sales and purchase order posting to avoid locking

features.name: Waiting Status for Queued Jobs
features.description: Added a new status code 'waiting' to indicate when a job is sleeping in the queue waiting for its turn to execute, corresponding to the previous figurative hang-up behavior.

features.name: Job Queue Priority Support
features.description: Introduced priority support within category codes to allow jobs to skip the queue if marked with higher priority, useful for urgent tasks like orders with trucks waiting outside.
caveats: Priority only applies within the same category code
Requires manual prioritization of urgent jobs

features.name: Improved Execution Order in Job Queue
features.description: By implementing a proper queue with sequential numbering instead of random retry attempts, jobs now execute in first-in-first-out order rather than the previous random execution order.
